notes.title: Devlog #23 - "I Am Jesus Christ" Release Results To Beta Testers!
notes.notes:
Hi

We are glad to present a new devlog 23 of development "I Am Jesus Christ". '
As we promised, we released to our community access to Beta testing of Alpha version. First 250 players got access and left awesome feedbacks! If you missed your chance - don't worry, 
we will open another such opportunity right before Christmas time. 
Also, 10 most active members at our Discord channel will get free access to full game!
All of that and more in this special video...

[previewyoutube=GQOvKcCn1L8;full][/previewyoutube]

More news will come shortly...
